bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs (local store), springboard/apps/contacts-desktop (Contacts app), springboard/src/shell/quicksearch.rs (search index), springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs (vCard export); no SDK module
summary: BifrOSt has a shell-internal local contact store (one flat file, fixed fields, atomic save) that the Contacts app, Search and Share use directly. Apps get no SDK contacts API, and no permission, change-history, group, container or contacts-changed mechanism exists.

features.note: Store is a shell module. The Contacts app reaches it by crate path (springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs:20), not through springboard/sdk/src/. Apps have no fetch or save call.

features.apple: Accessing the contact store; NSContactsUsageDescription; contact access button and picker
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No permission prompt or per-app grant. Any code in the shell reads the whole file.

Fixed fields: name, phone, email, notes, company, address, favorite, and three label indexes. No multi-value lists (one phone, one email, one address), no birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs, images or nickname.
Fixed English label sets (mobile, home, work, other) indexed by number. No custom labels, no localized label strings.

Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. Every fetch loads all fields. No key list and no partial contacts. Search covers name, phone, email, notes, company and address.
Whole-file atomic rewrite on each save. Invalid input is rejected and the old file is kept. No batch of add, update and delete operations and no per-record change.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_changes.rs, springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs, springboard/ui/src/vcard.rs; wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_groups.rs (wired in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs and group_file.rs)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. One flat list with no groups, containers or subgroups. Contacts keeps a lists sidebar in the app, but it has no group data behind it. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: CNChangeHistoryFetchRequest, CNChangeHistoryEvent family, CNChangeHistoryEventVisitor, Contacts changed notifications
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No change log and no notification to other apps when contacts change. Search results are rebuilt from the store when the file is loaded.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/contactstore.rs:Contact::display_name, Contact::initials; wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_display.rs (sort order wired in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs and display_file.rs; name display order still missing); wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/names.rs (NameOrder, shown); View menu in src/contacts.rs (main_menu, set_name_order)
features.note: Display name falls back name, company, phone, email. Initials are computed. No locale-aware name order and no postal address formatter. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.bifrost: springboard/src/shell/share/mod.rs:33 (Item::from_contact builds a vCard card); wired: springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/exchange.rs via File menu
features.note: Export only, for Share. No vCard import and no parse of a vCard to a Contact. The share module is not a Contacts API. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

Wave 6 (b03, main): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on Midget. No contact display preferences such as sort order or name order. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 5 (0.5.43); verify on Midget for parity.

features.apple: Spotlight-style indexing of contacts (no direct CNContact symbol)
features.note: Shell Search returns contacts from the store. Apps index their own content through the SDK quicksearch module, which the contact store does not use.

features.apple: Contact access button, Contact access picker (sample code)
features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/contact_access.rs (model only; wired: springboard/ui/src/contact_picker.rs (Add People picker in springboard/apps/contacts-desktop/src/contacts.rs)
features.note: Wave 2 (theme-30, parity/integration e52c2fd0): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No picker that lets an app receive one chosen contact without seeing the whole store. Wired into the UI in wiring wave 2 (0.5.38); verify on Midget for parity.
Errors are std io errors with fixed text (Invalid contact, Contacts file too large, Unknown contacts format). No typed error codes for apps.
Notes are plain text with a 4000-character limit, with no entitlement. No contact photo or thumbnail data.

gaps: No SDK contacts module: apps cannot fetch, search, create or save contacts (springboard/sdk/src/ has no contacts file).
No permission model for contact access (NSContactsUsageDescription equivalent, per-app grant, contact access picker).
No change history and no contacts-changed notification to apps.
Single-valued fields only: one phone, one email, one address. No birthday, dates, relations, social profiles, instant messages, URLs or photos.
No vCard import and no vCard-to-contact parse.
No key-based partial fetch; every read loads the whole store (cap 10,000 contacts, 8 MiB file).
